texts.en:
Habitable £planet£ Planets are divided into £district£ Districts, Zones, and £building£ Buildings.

£dot_green£Districts can consist of multiple Zones
£dot_green£Zones determine which £job£ Jobs are created
£dot_green£Buildings grant bonuses to the Zones

More Building slots are unlocked as the zones are upgraded.

There are two ways of viewing a planet;
From the Galaxy Map or the Outliner.

£dot_green£ Select a Planet
£dot_green£ Click on the different tabs
